purpose: Prospective 2x2 marker/surface diagnostic on frozen image-only division probes and existing saved predictions.

core_marker_recipe.free_mask: interior > 0.5 AND boundary < source-selected threshold AND no building seed AND outside fixed OSM barrier
core_marker_recipe.admission: same minimum 40 m2 on the remaining core and same 2 px building exclusion as native markers
core_marker_recipe.identity: one new label per admitted core; preserve all original building marker pixels and labels
core_marker_recipe.no_fallback: a rejected or erased component does not get a substitute marker

geometry: unchanged exact-cell constructor; no smoothing, contour filtering, cleanup or repair
control: native-distance label raster must exactly equal each saved no-small-region-merge raster; probe outcomes and geometry counts must reproduce the previous exact-cell report
invariants: same OSM barriers in all variants
each marker map identical across surface variants
diagnostics: Before flooding: per-probe same positive marker, different positive markers, one unseeded or both unseeded; zero is absence, never a marker identity.
Boundary probability sampled along the straight anchor connector: quantiles/maximum are descriptive only, not visibility evidence or boundary recall.
Image/boundary/marker overlays for all nine images and three seeds; distinguish visual assessment from measured probe outcomes.
secondary: OSM building area retained by one output feature
predicted-boundary support on final internal shared edges
support_metric: Internal shared edges between different positive raster labels only; score their average adjacent-cell boundary probability and length below 0.3. This measures model support, not verified physical support; exclude exterior and zero-label edges.
decision: Descriptive comparison only. Seek fewer final-polygon false joins without lost pair coverage; report every paired change, seed, new join, fragment and building-cut outcome. A candidate cannot advance on an aggregate gain that hides losses. No weights, significance claim, model promotion or runtime change.
limits: Same previously inspected Croatian development geography and agent-draft probes. Learned boundary support cannot validate itself; unsupported physical cuts and building reality still require human image review. No held-out final/confirmation imagery or cadastral labels are read.
